opportunities.name: Lotus Magic Trap
opportunities.objective: Measure E hit rate under allied mark plus W.
opportunities.mechanic: E has 1 AP plus 1.2 AD magic damage and detonates after two seconds. W can root a target damaged by an ally to hold the trap; Rylai tests post-explosion retention, Shadowflame supports low-health magic damage and AP also contributes to Q physical damage.
opportunities.requiredState: Enemy triggers E and W root condition is met before it detonates.
opportunities.failure: Opponent escapes before two seconds or AP severely lowers conventional shooting damage.
opportunities.test: Measure E hit rate under allied mark plus W; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: E scaling with AD does not turn its damage physical.

opportunities.name: Crit Speed Reposition
opportunities.objective: Measure movement after crit and fourth-shot access with the same firing timeline.
opportunities.mechanic: P has a fixed firing rate, converts bonus attack-speed stat into AD, and gives crit movement scaling with that stat. Attack-speed crit items can test per-shot movement and fourth-shot access rather than firing faster; Q kills before later bounces can prepare missing-health fourth-shot damage.
opportunities.requiredState: Record four-shot ammo state and land crits before moving to the next angle.
opportunities.failure: Reload downtime and inaccessible targets erase per-shot gains.
opportunities.test: Measure movement after crit and fourth-shot access with the same firing timeline; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Bonus attack speed does not increase Jhin's fixed attack cadence.

ruledOut.reason: P explicitly fixes attack rate and converts attack-speed investment into other bonuses.

unknowns: Stat(4)/Stat(8) conversion basis and E ammo refresh formula are symbolic; fourth R shot has its own crit rule.
StatFormula annotations remain symbolic; verify the affected stat basis before numerical comparison.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Opponent escapes before two seconds or AP severely lowers conventional shooting damage.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: E scaling with AD does not turn its damage physical.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Luden's Echo, Rylai's Crystal Scepter, Shadowflame, Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Sorcerer's Shoes. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

Passive: Champions Jhin kills will create and detonate a Lotus Trap at their location.

Active: Jhin places an invisible Lotus Trap for [3] minutes that creates a zone that Slows by [35]% when stepped on by an enemy. After [2] seconds, the trap detonates, dealing [20 / 80 / 140 / 200 / 260 + (1.2) × AD + (1) × AP] magic damage.

This ability has 2 charges ([(24 / 21.5 / 19 / 16.5 / 14 + ((1) × Stat(10)) × (24 / 21.5 / 19 / 16.5 / 14))] second refresh).

Jhin fires a long range shot dealing [70 / 105 / 140 / 175 / 210 + (0.5) × AD] physical damage to the first champion hit and other enemies along the way.

If this skill strikes a champion that has been damaged by an allied champion within the last [4] seconds, it will Root them for [1.25 / 1.5 / 1.75 / 2 / 2.25] seconds and grant Jhin Whisper's Move Speed.

Jhin launches a cartridge that deals [44 / 69 / 94 / 119 / 144 + (0.44 / 0.515 / 0.59 / 0.665 / 0.74) × AD + (0.6) × AP] physical damage before bouncing to a nearby enemy that has not been hit yet.

The cartridge can hit a maximum of [(1 + 3)] times. Enemies that die shortly after being hit increase the damage of subsequent hits by [35]%.
